Local image text recovery assets. Tesseract.js 7.0.0 and Tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 (https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js and https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core). English fast language data from https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast, as distributed with tesseract-ocr-eng. Apache 2.0 licenses and notices are included. Only image recovery loads these assets; images are processed in the browser, without a remote OCR service.
